text.p: Argentine consumer prices rose 0.2 percent in September, compared with a 0.2 percent rise in September 1995 and a drop of 0.1 percent in August, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
Wholesale prices rose 1.2 percent, compared with 0.9 percent in September last year and a fall of 0.3 percent in August.
In the 12-month period to September consumer prices rose 0.2 percent and wholesale prices 2.7 percent, the ministry said in its monthly inflation report.
Analysts had forecast 0.1 percent inflation in September, but the rate was pushed up by a 0.7 percent rise in the food and beverage sector.
